raw_context: Because - BNK (track title, Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): abbreviation for 'Break Na Kami' meaning 'We broke up / We have already broken up'; Filipino text/internet slang that turns the phrase into a 3-letter acronym
Because - Marlboro Black 3 (Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): "'Sino ba jowa mo, sinong Because'" — gender-neutral slang for boyfriend or girlfriend / romantic partner

Because - Marlboro Black 3 (Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): "na sobrang na wasak ka na mapapasindi ka na lang ng sigarilyo" — to be completely heartbroken/destroyed emotionally; also used more broadly for wrecked, drunk, or high
Because - Marlboro Black 3 (Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): "'Kala mo mahika kaha ng yosi nasa kaliwa" — slang for cigarette; derived from syllable inversion of sigarilyo (SI-garil-YO → YO-SI)

Because - SUPLADA (track title, Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): a girl who is cold, aloof, snobbish, or unfriendly; feminine form of suplado; song uses it as a term for a girl who ignores or plays hard to get

Because - Talksick (track title, Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): Taglish portmanteau/phrase meaning to rap impressively and with skill; combines English 'talk' (to rap) + 'sick' (excellent/impressive in hip-hop slang)

Because - Heartbreak SZN 3 (album title series, 2018/2024): abbreviated form of English 'season,' stylized shorthand widely used in Filipino youth and social media context (e.g., 'ghost SZN', 'cuffing SZN')

Because - PAUSOK feat. Allison Shore (Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): informal Filipino verb for taking a puff or drag from a cigarette or vape; literally 'to suck smoke'; common in youth smoking/vaping culture

Because - Marlboro Black 3 (Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): "ika'y grabe kumabig" — intensifier used to mean extreme, intense, serious, or unbelievable; informal Tagalog exclamation used across many emotional registers (awe, frustration, admiration)

Because - NO SHADE (track title, Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): borrowed from English/AAVE slang meaning 'no ill intent' or 'not trying to offend'; used in Filipino youth speech to soften a potentially critical statement

Because - PAUSOK feat. Allison Shore (track title, Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): informal Filipino term for smoking or causing smoke; from root word 'usok' (smoke) with causative prefix 'pa-'; colloquially used for smoking/vaping sessions

Because - BB GANG (track title, Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): affectionate text/internet abbreviation for 'baby' or 'babe'; widely used in Filipino youth chat and social media as a term of endearment toward a romantic partner

Because - Swerte (track title, Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): 'luck' or 'lucky'; from Spanish 'suerte'; used by Filipino youth informally to mean lucky or fortunate, often in romantic contexts (e.g., 'swerte mo naman' = you're so lucky)

Because - Swerte (Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): "'Di na ko babaero pero ngiti ko ay totoo" — a womanizer or playboy; from babae (woman) + Spanish suffix -ero; also featured in Hev Abi collaboration; confirms cross-artist usage

Because - AYOKO NA feat. SUPAFLY (track title, Heartbreak SZN 3, 2024): 'I don't want to anymore' / 'I give up'; common Filipino expression of emotional exhaustion or resignation, especially in breakup/relationship contexts
